To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the colour gluons are vector bosons and that they are responsible for the asymptotic freedom of the quarks.
the colour gluons do not spoil scaling in deep inelastic scattering, and that the integrally charged partons behave as fractionally charge partons in the asymptotic limit.

in the asymptotically large energy region the colour gluons do not contribute to the deep inelastic structure functions of the quarks and that in this region the colour octet components of the weak and electromagetic currents of the quark are damped.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: What is the role of the colour gluons in deep inelastic processes?
the study of the properties of the colour gluons in deep inelastic scattering.
a unified gauge theory which is based on the group SU (3)color ⊗ SU (2)L ⊗ U(1) and is a generalization of Weinberg’s model to include the colour gluons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the asymptotic scaling behaviour of the deep inelastic structure functions of the quarks and the scaling behaviour of their electromagnetic form factors, as well as their weak form factors at high energy, can be understood in a unified way within the parton picture in the asymptotic limit of high energy, if one assumes that the partons are integrally charged quark and coloured gluon fields and if one treats the theory in the framework of a unified gauge model of the type SU (3)colour ⊗
the colour gluon contributions to deep inelastic scattering processes are negligible in the asymptotic regime and that the scaling violations are due to the mass of the quarks.

in a unified gauge theory the integrally charged partons behave as fractionally or even zero-charge partons in deep inelastic lepton-hadron scattering, and this behaviour is a consequence of gauge invariance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the asymptotic freedom of the integrally charged colour gluons is a consequence of their coupling to the weak and electromagnetic vector bosons.
, within the unified gauge model of SU (3)colour ⊗ SU (2) ⊗ U (1), the integrally charged coloured quarks and gluons can be used to describe deep inelastic processes in a consistent and simple way.
in this model the integrally charged coloured gluons do not spoil the parton picture of deep inelastic scattering, although their participation is essential to the maintenance of gauge symmetry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the colour gluons do not spoil scaling in a unified model.
the colour gluons do not contribute to deep inelastic weak and/or electromagnetic scattering at asymptotically high energies.
the gluon contribution to the structure functions is not a perturbation in this asymptotic region.
